full_judgment: 2. The subjuct-matter of the writ petition is a fishery known as Kamraghop Beel Fishery which is situated on SA plot No. 1448 of Mouza Athukura within police station Baniachang of Habiganj district. The petitioner's father and 13 others took settlement of the said fishery from Kali Prashad Chakraborty and others, ex-landlords of Nayasarak Sylhet. On the death of his father the petitioner became an owner thereof along with the co-sharers. They had no rent-receiving interest. During the survey settlement made under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 the said SA plot No. 1448 was recorded in the khatian No. 1 of respondent No. 1, but its area was wrongly recorded as 0.38 acre in place of the actual area of 65.38 acres.
